# # dev traj 

## overall

```{r}
# overall dev trajectories

dfs_viz$long %>%
  filter(instar %in% c("3rd", "4th", "5th", "wander", "pupa")) %>%
  group_by(pop, trt, trt.type, trt.minT, instar) %>%
  CalcDevSS() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = avg.logmass, x = avg.tt,
             shape = instar, lty = pop, col = interaction(trt.minT, trt.type),
             group = interaction(pop, trt.type, trt.minT))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~pop)
```


## by sup

```{r}
# shared prep + plotting
.prepfn <- function(x){
  x %>%
    filter(!is.na(pop),
           !is.na(is.sup)) %>%
    filter(instar %in% c("wander") | grepl("\\d.*", instar)) %>%
    mutate(sup = case_when(is.na(sup) ~ 5,
                           TRUE ~ sup),
           across(c("sup", starts_with("is.")), ~ as.factor(.x))) %>%
    group_by(year, pop, trt, trt.type, trt.minT, instar, 
             is.sup, sup, .add = TRUE) %>%
    CalcDevSS() %>%
    ungroup()
}

.plotfn <- function(x){
  x %>%
    arrange(desc(pop)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y = avg.logmass, x = avg.tt,
               col = pop, lty = pop, shape = sup
    )) +
    facet_grid(year ~ trt, labeller = labeller(trt = c(p_scales$labs_trt))
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "ln[mass]", x = "days to instar",
         col = "population", lty = "population") +
    guides(lty = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1),
                              order = 1),
           col = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1),
                              order = 1),
           shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1),
                                order = 3)
    ) 
}
```

### successful pups only

```{r}
# successful pups only
dfs_viz$long %>%
  filter(is.pup > 0) %>% 
  .prepfn() %>% #View()
  .plotfn() +
  geom_point(size = 1.75, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(shape = "instars to\npupation",
       caption = "trajectory of successful pupations")
#ResToFig("supp_dev-traj")
```

### pmd + pups

```{r}
# shared dfs
df <- dfs_viz$wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(is.pup), 
         !is.na(jdate.5th),
         ) %>%
  DevToLong() %>%
  mutate(is.pup = case_when(is.pup > 1 ~ 1,
                            TRUE ~ is.pup),
         is.pup = factor(is.pup, levels = c(1, 0))) %>%
  group_by(is.pup) %>% 
  .prepfn() #%>% View()
```



```{r}
# V2: separate out yrs
.plotfn2 <- function(x){
  x %>%
    .plotfn() +
    geom_point(size = 1.75, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
    aes(col = is.pup, lty = is.pup, #alpha = is.pup,
        group = interaction(is.pup, sup)
    ) +
    labs(col = "outcome", lty = "outcome", 
         shape = "instars to outcome",
         #caption = paste0(df$year, " 5ths + sups outcomes")

                       labels = c(`0` = "died", `1` = "pupated")) +
    scale_linetype_discrete(labels = c(`0` = "died", `1` = "pupated"))
}
```

# # misc development

## per instar growth rate

```{r}
dfs_viz$wide %>%
  mutate(#per instar
         pgr.3rd = log(mass.3rd)/tt.3rd,
         pgr.4th = log(mass.4th-mass.3rd)/(jdate.4th-jdate.3rd),
         pgr.5th = log(mass.5th-mass.4th)/(jdate.5th-jdate.4th),
         pgr.wander = log(mass.wander-mass.5th)/(jdate.wander-jdate.5th),
         
         #mean
         mgr.3rd = log(mass.3rd)/tt.3rd,
         mgr.4th = log(mass.4th)/tt.4th,
         mgr.5th = log(mass.5th)/tt.5th,
         mgr.wander = log(mass.wander)/tt.wander
         ) %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with(c("pgr", "mgr")), ~replace(.x, is.infinite(.x), NA))) %>% #View()
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with(c("pgr", "mgr")),
               names_to = c("type", "instar"),
               values_to = "gr",
               names_sep = "\\.",
               values_drop_na = TRUE) %>% #View()
  group_by(pop, trt, trt.minT, trt.type, type, instar) %>%
  summarise(across(.cols = gr,
                     .fns = list(avg = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 se = se),
                     .names = "{.fn}.{.col}")) %>% #View()
  mutate(instar = factor(instar, levels = c("3rd", "4th", "5th", "wander"))) %>%
  filter(instar != "3rd",
         #type == "mgr"
         ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = avg.gr, x = instar,
             shape = trt.type, lty = trt.type, col = trt.minT,
             group = interaction(trt.minT, trt.type))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar((aes(ymax = avg.gr + se.gr,
                     ymin = avg.gr - se.gr)),
                lty = "solid", width = 0.25, show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(type~pop, #nrow = 1
             scales = "free") +
  scale_color_hue(direction = -1) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(y = "per instar growth rate (ln(g)/day)")
```



## time per instar

```{r}
# do diff trts spend diff times at diff instars? (i.e. can we see the lag vs ctrl growing over time in later stages?)
  # seems like yes? see final larval instar (wander) = biggest lag...

# (maybe just plot the difference btwn ctrl instead?)

dfs_viz$wide %>%
  #filter(is.na(jdate.6th)) %>% # < 5ths only
  mutate(length.wander = case_when(!is.na(jdate.8th) ~ jdate.wander - jdate.8th,
                                   !is.na(jdate.7th) ~ jdate.wander - jdate.7th,
                                   !is.na(jdate.6th) ~ jdate.wander - jdate.6th,
                                   !is.na(jdate.5th) ~ jdate.wander - jdate.5th),
         length.5th = jdate.5th - jdate.4th,
         length.4th = jdate.4th - jdate.3rd,
         # no 3rd bc only have from hatching
         ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("length"),
               names_to = c(".value", "instar"),
               values_drop_na = TRUE,
               names_pattern = ("([a-z]*\\d*)\\.(\\d*[a-z]*)")) %>%
  group_by(pop, trt, trt.type, trt.minT, instar) %>%
  arrange(trt) %>%
  summarise(avg.length = mean(length, na.rm = TRUE),
            se.length = se(length)) %>% #View()
  ggplot(aes(y = avg.length, x = trt.minT,
             col = trt.type, shape = pop,
             lty = pop,
             group = interaction(trt.type, pop))) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymax = avg.length + se.length,
                    ymin = avg.length - se.length),
                width = 0.3, lty = "solid", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(~instar) +
  labs(y = "instar duration (days)",
       x = "larval Tmin",
       caption = "duration = time from previous larval instar") +
  scale_color_hue(direction = -1) +
  theme_bw()
  
```


## time in 5th/instars

do bugs get the same level of HS as meggans bugs?
(no -- bugs spend more cumulative time at 40C)

```{r}
dfs_viz$wide %>%
  mutate(length.5th = tt.wander - tt.5th) %>%
  group_by(pop, trt, #year
           ) %>%
  summarise(mean.5th = mean(length.5th, na.rm = TRUE),
            se.5th = se(length.5th)) #%>% View()
```

are ctrl bugs taking longer to grow?
(yes, for the lab...) -- no major sex differences

```{r}
df <- dfs_viz$wide %>%
  filter(is.sup == 0,
         #!is.na(sex)
         ) %>%
  mutate(length.5th = tt.wander - tt.5th,
         length.4th = tt.5th - tt.4th,
         length.3rd = tt.4th - tt.3rd,
         growth.5th = mass.wander - mass.5th,
         growth.4th = mass.5th - mass.4th,
         growth.3rd = mass.4th - mass.3rd,
         across(starts_with("growth"), ~ log(.x))) %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with(c("length", "growth")),
               names_to = c(".value", "instar"),
               names_sep = "\\.") %>% #View()
  group_by(pop, trt, year, instar,
           #sex
           ) %>%
  summarise(across(c("length", "growth"),
            .fns = list(mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        se = se),
            .names = "{.fn}_{.col}")) %>% #View()
  pivot_longer(starts_with(c("mean_", "se_")),
              names_to = c(".value", "metric"),
              names_sep = "_")
  
df %>%  
  filter(trt == 260) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = instar, x = mean,
             lty = sex, col = year, shape = instar,
             group = interaction(pop, sex, year))
         ) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  facet_grid(pop~metric,
             scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "mean change")
```

```{r}
# get R^2
df <- dfs_viz$wide %>%
  filter(is.ec == 1,
         tt.eclose < 60) %>%
  mutate(mass.pupa = mass.pupa/1000,
         mass.eclose = mass.eclose/1000,
         pct.loss = 1 - (mass.eclose/mass.pupa))

mods <- list(
  lab = lm(tt.eclose ~ mass.pupa, data = df %>% filter(pop == "lab")),
  field = lm(tt.eclose ~ mass.pupa, data = df %>% filter(pop == "field")),
  lab2 = lm(tt.eclose ~ pct.loss + sex, data = df %>% filter(pop == "lab")),
  field2 = lm(tt.eclose ~ pct.loss + sex, data = df %>% filter(pop == "field"))
)

summary(mods$lab) # y = -0.05464x + 24.75 (adj R^2 = -0.003)
summary(mods$field) # y = 0.7807x + 24.95 (adj R^2 = 0.003)

summary(mods$lab2) # y = 5.748x + 21.464 (adj R^2 = 0.009494)
summary(mods$field2) # y = 1.765x + 26.362 (adj R^2 = -0.005011 )
```

# # adult correlations

## adult size distribution

```{r}
# sizes of adults
dfs_viz$wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mass.eclose),
         year != 2024,
         if.fridge == 0,
         if.mated == 1) %>%
  mutate(mass.eclose = mass.eclose/1000) %>%
  #DevToLong() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mass.eclose, fill = pop)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, #position = "stack"
                 ) +
  facet_grid(year ~ trt, 
             #scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(trt = p_scales$labs_trt)
             ) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "adult mass (g)")
```

## adult mass & lifespan

```{r}
dfs_viz$wide %>%
  filter(!is.na(mass.eclose),
         year != 2024,
         if.fridge == 0,
         if.mated == 1) %>%
  mutate(mass.eclose = mass.eclose/1000) %>%
  #DevToLong() %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = tt.long,x = mass.eclose, 
             shape = pop, col = year)) +
  geom_smooth(aes(lty = pop), method = "lm", lwd = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  # facet_grid(year ~ trt,

  #            ) +
  # theme(axis.text = element_text(angle = 45)) +
  theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~sex) +
  labs(x = "adult mass (g)")
```
